jobs.title: Recruiter, G&A or GTM
jobs.reason: This is a recruiting / talent-acquisition role (HR function), which is off the candidate's profile regardless of Anthropic's AI-policy prestige. It also requires a track record of full-cycle recruiting (preferred 4+ years) that the candidate does not have. Field mismatch on the function plus a seniority gap.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor (Social Compliance Auditor)
jobs.reason: This is a social-compliance auditing role requiring specialist auditor certifications (APSCA/CSCA, SA8000) and 3–4 years of audit experience with 200+ verifiable audit days — well outside the candidate's research/policy profile and experience level. The "Lead" title and experience expectations also place it above entry-level. Field, skills and seniority all fail.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Reviewer
jobs.reason: This is a welding/engineering certification role requiring an Engineering degree, 4–6 years' experience and an International Welding Engineer qualification — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy profile. Senior title with hard experience and specialist technical/licensing requirements the candidate cannot meet.

jobs.title: Strategic Program Manager, Worker Survey
jobs.reason: This is a commercial program-management and business-development role in ESG/CSR — only adjacent to the candidate's policy profile and centred on client engagement rather than research. It also explicitly requires a minimum of 5 years' experience (a hard 3+ bar) and a "Manager" title, which the candidate cannot meet; hard ineligibility on seniority/experience.

jobs.title: Lead Report Reviewer
jobs.reason: This is a quality-assurance role reviewing responsible-sourcing/ESG audit reports for technical completeness — not policy, IR, intelligence or research work, so it sits off the candidate's profile. The "Lead" title and expected audit/ESG/compliance experience also exceed the candidate's entry-level stage.

jobs.title: LGBT Rights Program (ECA) Intern
jobs.reason: Field fit is strong (human rights research and law/policy monitoring), but the role is excluded on multiple grounds: it requires an enrolled student eligible for a mandatory pflichtpraktikum (a study-time internship, not genuine entry-level), offers only a stipend rather than a salary, and is based in Berlin while the location policy is London only. Any of these forces a Low.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO and Chair
jobs.reason: The stated deadline (22 June) has passed relative to today's date (2026-06-23), so the role is treated as closed. Separately, an executive-assistant role is administrative and off the candidate's research/policy profile.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: The deadline (15 January 2026) has passed relative to today (2026-06-23), so the role is closed. Additionally, this is an expert Advisory Committee call seeking established experts (not entry-level) and a Spanish-language version suggests Spanish capability is expected for the work, neither of which the candidate meets.

jobs.title: Digital Associate Director, Health
jobs.reason: This is a senior digital/social-media communications role in healthcare PR, outside the candidate's policy/IR/intelligence profile and requiring specialist healthcare-comms and regulatory expertise the candidate lacks. The "Associate Director" title with "significant experience" required is well above entry level — hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Account Director - DxI - Human Intelligence
jobs.reason: This is a senior "Account Director" role requiring deep, proven pharma and healthcare expertise plus team leadership — far beyond the candidate's MSc-in-progress and student/RA experience (hard ineligibility on seniority). The work is commercial communications intelligence for healthcare clients, off the candidate's policy/IR/geopolitical-risk profile, and demands sector-specific expertise they lack.
